layers.message: Add records store and list command
Document the command-line tool and operations
Record project context for CSV export

prompt.utterance: Document the CSV export capability as a vertical slice across all of its documentation.

graderOnly: The documentation surfaces relevant to the CSV export are the README Usage section, docs/cli.md (the CLI reference), docs/operations.md (the operator guide), and the Python docstrings in recordbook/export.py and recordbook/cli.py.

None of README.md, docs/cli.md, or docs/operations.md mentions the export command yet; docs/operations.md still says recordbook only reads the data file and writes no files of its own, which is no longer true.
The recordbook/cli.py module docstring still lists only the list command, and the write_export docstring does not mention that it refuses to replace an existing file unless force is set.

The implementation satisfies AC-001 and has no material defects; the export behavior is: python3 -m recordbook [--data PATH] export with --status, --owner, -q/--query, -o/--output, --export-dir (default RECORDBOOK_EXPORT_DIR or exports), and --force; default file records-YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ.csv in UTC; CRLF rows with RFC 4180 quoting; the written path on stdout and an exported N records line on stderr; exit 1 when the file exists or the data file is missing, exit 2 for an invalid option such as an unknown status.

The project contains only Python and Markdown: no TypeScript, HTML, or CSS, so of the Documenter technology styles only styles/python.md is relevant (plus the always-loaded styles/universal.md). The Documenter skill has only modes/autonomous.md and modes/guided.md; there is no vertical-slice mode file.

selfChecks.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d) && python3 -m recordbook export -o $d/a.csv && python3 -m recordbook export -o $d/a.csv

the DOCUMENTING state and records are valid

notes: Standalone fixture (export-documenting is TypeScript with no CLI, operator guide, or Python docstrings, so it cannot hold the case's surfaces or the python-only style expectation). Pre-install: 00-project commits a stdlib Python CLI `recordbook` (store, argparse list command, pyproject with pytest settings, data/records.json with six records incl. a comma and double quotes, 6 tests); 05-docs commits README Usage, docs/cli.md (CLI reference), docs/operations.md (operator guide). Installer then brownfield with hooks. Post-install commits in brownfield order: context (STATE SCOPING), scope with AC-001 (CSV export behavior) and AC-002 (accurate usage documentation), design (AC-002 no architectural impact, Documenter), APPROVED plan, implementation (recordbook/export.py, export subcommand in cli.py, tests/test_export.py with 8 tests, .gitignore exports/), plan COMPLETE (STATE TESTING), COMPLETE FULL verification with AC-002 pending Documenter (STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION), COMPLETE implementation review with no findings (STATE DOCUMENTING, FORWARD from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION). Recovery/obligations inactive, BlockedOn NONE, no documentation record, no user styles. The docs have no export coverage; operations.md claims the tool writes no files; the cli module docstring lists only list. The utterance names the vertical-slice target because the case states it as the user's choice.
